limits: Owned local bare receiver over a pinned existing object history; no real user worktree/remote mutation, network throughput or Graph timing in the primary series.
Node CPU/RSS covers the benchmark process only. Git children, Chromium, concurrent total memory and whole-OS CPU are excluded.
Uncontrolled external load and about 18.8GiB swap usage were observed. Do not infer a universal percentage from these local samples.
Unknown server tips remain conservative and are not used as exclusion proof. This does not eliminate all history walks.
Direct API calls without upstream setup can use a narrow destination probe followed by full branch discovery. The upstream-setting path reuses one advertisement.

node.note: The initial failure detected missing caller wiring for advertisement reuse; focused final-source tests cover the changed paths. Counts are unique test names across the two runs, not a single passing 102-case run.
